title: Indonesia | World Coffee Guide
description: Most of the crop is robusta from southern Sumatra. The arabica on specialty menus is a smaller pile: Gayo, Lintong, Toraja, Kintamani, Flores, a little Java and Papua.
seoDescription: Indonesia coffee guide: wet-hulled arabica, Gayo and Lintong, and the robusta belt in southern Sumatra.
